stories.title: Ontario fugitive arrested in Winnipeg hours after making most wanted list
stories.summary: An Ontario fugitive wanted in connection with two Toronto-area shootings was arrested in Winnipeg Thursday, less than six hours after being placed on Canada’s most wanted list.

stories.title: Warning of credit rating downgrade ‘not a hinge moment’: Ontario finance minister
stories.summary: Ontario's Finance Minister is expressing confidence that the province will be able to avoid a credit rating downgrade amid "negative outlook" forcast

stories.title: Ontario Liberals to select third new leader since 2018
stories.summary: Ontario's Liberal Party will wrap up a long leadership race Saturday, and, they hope, an even longer stretch without a long-term leader.

stories.title: Sens’ Ersson has night to forget in loss to Flyers
stories.summary: Travis Green said there are some nights you play well and don't win.

stories.title: Maple Leafs blow big lead as ugly run continues
stories.summary: William Nylander found Dakota Joshua off the rush with a pinpoint pass.

stories.title: Kings hand Maple Leafs eighth straight loss
stories.summary: Adrian Kempe scored the only goal of the shootout as the Los Angeles Kings roared back from a 3-0 deficit to pick up a 4-3 victory over Toronto to send the Maple Leafs to their eighth straight loss Thursday.

stories.title: Efficient Martin getting more minutes for Raptors
stories.summary: Alijah Martin has been waiting for a moment like this.

stories.title: Ontario father finds unanchored soccer nets in community where son died
stories.summary: The father of a 15-year-old who was killed by an unsecured soccer net said he was "disappointed" to find non-anchored goalposts in the town where his son died at in 2017.

stories.title: Barrett, Murray-Boyles put on Raptors injured list
stories.summary: The Toronto Raptors have sidelined forwards RJ Barrett and Collin Murray-Boyles.

stories.title: Former colleges and universities minister refuses to answer OSAP questions
stories.summary: Ontario's former minister of colleges and universities, who presided over the file for three years until 2024, is refusing to answer questions about a growing OSAP scandal.
